description: Add an MCP server to ManyCP from its public GitHub repo. ManyCP reads the repo (README, package.json or pyproject.toml, server.json, Dockerfile), finds npm, PyPI, Docker and remote endpoints, writes a draft listing (title, short description, categories, tags, tools, install config), saves it, and returns the listing, any warnings, and the plan for every directory that fits. It does not submit anywhere: review the listing, fix it with update_listing, then call submit_server. Adding a repo that is already added is an error that names the existing server. Needs a launch credit ($19 per server, once), Starter (3 servers) or Pro (unlimited).

repo_url.description: The public GitHub repo: https://github.com/owner/name, or just owner/name.

name: add_server
title: Add a server from GitHub
